description: Creates a draft Markdown document in Content Studio, from Markdown text or by converting a web page (source_url) to Markdown. Drafts are not public until published.

lang.description: Language code, e.g. en, pl. Defaults to the site language.

site.description: Site domain, e.g. example.com. Optional when the account has one site.

slug.description: Defaults to a slug of the title

source_url.description: Page to convert to Markdown instead of markdown

name: create_document
title: Create draft document
